jobs.description: Mit einem Umsatz von € 1.812 Mio. im Jahr 2024 ist PERI international einer der größten Hersteller und Anbieter von Schalungs- und Gerüstsystemen. Das Familienunternehmen mit Stammsitz in Weißenhorn bedient mit rund 10.000 Mitarbeitern und deutlich mehr als 140 Lagerstandorten in über 63 Ländern seine Kunden mit innovativen Systemgeräten und umfangreichen Serviceleistungen rund um die Schalungs- und Gerüsttechnik.What you'll do - your area of impact:Turning complex supply chains into smart, digital flows.We're searching for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Expert with a strong focus on Production Planning (PP)- someone who brings deep industry understanding, process excellence, and the technical chops to drive digital transformation from concept to go-live.- Take the lead in designing and implementing processes for our production plants- Provide hands-on customizing and process consulting in the line-of-business "Manufacturing"- Ensure seamless integration across modules like purchasing, warehouse management, sales, and maintenance- Support the implementation and adaptation of Fiori apps and mobile solutions in production and logistics environments- Act as a key advisor for production teams and business stakeholders throughout the ERP transformation journey- Align production and logistics flows with IT architecture and corporate standards- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enable lean, agile production environments- Train and support useresWhat you bring - your expert profile:- Degree in Business Informatics, Computer Science or a comparable qualification- Proven experience as SAP S/4HANA consultant or in-house expert in PP and other logistics modules- Deep understanding of SAP customizing, process integration and interface topics- Confident in working with Fiori, mobile use cases, and modern UX strategies- Strong know-how in production planning, supply chain flows, and manufacturing processes - ideally within capital goods, construction materials, or wood/metal industries- Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills- Team player with a coaching attitude - you support others and lead by example- Good knowledge of German and EnglishWhy join us:- Remuneration and additional benefits that convince: With us, you can look forward to a pay scale including holiday pay and Christmas bonus. In addition, you can expect a company-sponsored pension scheme, capital-forming benefits and an employee referral program including a bonus.- Safe and healthy: With a secure job in a fast-growing and traditional family-owned company, you can look to the future without worries. You can also benefit from our health promotion (e.g.height-adjustable desks) and company fitness via EGYM with more than 4,500 network partners, bicycle leasing or PERI company sports groups.- Grow beyond yourself: Annual employee appraisals, further training advice and support, exchange and mentoring programmes as well as leadership training support you in your professional development. In our PERI Academy, you can take advantage of a wide range of training opportunities as well as free access to online learning platforms such as LinkedIn Learning and getAbstract.

jobs.occupation: (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search / AI Forge (Data Scientist)
jobs.description: Über diesen Job:CHECK24 is the comparison portal: We are both the market leader and a dynamic startup. Working in agile teams, we make fast decisions and embrace flat hierarchies. By leveraging the latest tools and technologies as well as state-of-the-art AI methods, we drive data-driven innovation – always focusing on creating added value for our customers. Across more than 50 products, we work every day to continuously improve the user experience of our more than 20 million customers.Our Search Team within CHECK24 AI Forge develops scalable AI solutions for search and ranking across different CHECK24 products. Search is a crucial entry and navigation point for our customers and covers challenging domains ranging from e-commerce product search and web-style navigation to travel search for hotels, destinations and other products.Search and Ranking are among the most demanding disciplines in applied machine learning. A successful system needs to understand user intent, retrieve relevant candidates, rank them effectively and meet demanding requirements for latency, scalability and measurable customer impact.To strengthen our team, we are looking for someone with first relevant hands-on experience who is eager to grow into a strong Applied Machine Learning Engineer. In this role, you will work on production systems combining classical information retrieval, deep learning, embeddings and Large Language Models and contribute across the entire lifecycle from initial idea and evaluation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.We look forward to receiving your application as a (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search at CHECK24 AI Forge GmbH.Was Du mitbringst:- You have successfully completed a degree (typically a Master's) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, electrical engineering or a comparable quantitative field, with strong grades in quantitative subjects- At least one year of relevant hands-on experience in machine learning or data science is part of your background, including relevant experience gained through working-student positions, internships or your own projects- Strong Python skills and practical experience with machine-learning or deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch are part of your technical toolkit- Solid classical machine-learning skills like gradient boosting, regression and feature engineering are evident in your CV, beyond LLM or RAG applications- You have practical experience with applications based on Large Language Models, LLM evaluation, tool use or agentic workflows- A solid understanding of machine-learning fundamentals and systematic model evaluation enables you to assess and improve model performance- Practical experience with APIs (e.g. FastAPI), containers and Git, ideally a deployed service, complements your interest in building complete production services- Knowledge of information retrieval, semantic search, recommender systems or learning-to-rank approaches is a plus- You have English proficiency at C1 level or higher; German is a plus but not requiredZu Deinen Aufgaben zählen:- You develop and improve machine-learning services for retrieval, ranking, query understanding and classification- Hybrid search solutions combine lexical retrieval, embeddings, neural models and components based on Large Language Models- Model development covers training, fine-tuning and systematic evaluation for semantic search, relevance prediction and learning-to-rank use cases- You create reliable evaluation datasets and metrics and validate improvements through offline evaluations, user signals and A/B tests- Production-ready services are built from prototypes using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Docker, PyTorch and vector databases- Modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows enable efficient prototyping, testing and continuous improvement- You research promising approaches in information retrieval, recommender systems and Large Language Models and translate them into measurable customer impactWas wir Dir bieten:Development and responsibility- Your commitment pays off – we support your talent and provide opportunities to grow your career quickly- Take ownership of your topics, contribute your own ideas, try new approaches and gradually assume responsibility for production Search and Ranking systems- Benefit from internal training with specialized coaches as well as an annual budget for external professional developmentTeam spirit and modern workspace- Experience team spirit in your daily work and beyond, whether over lunch, a game of table football or after-work activities, and celebrate our successes at regular company and team events- Work in an inspiring environment with a modern office and high-quality equipment such as MacBooks and height-adjustable desksFlexibility and balance- Fridays are home-office optional – and spending them in the office can earn you additional vacation days on top of your 28 days- Get to the office conveniently with your free Deutschlandticket or a subsidized company bicycle- Enjoy a free fresh lunch twice a week and use the opportunity to connect with your colleagues- Stay active with our internal sports classes or take advantage of our subsidized external sports offering, including EGYM Wellpass

We shape trust in the digital age!At G+D, we are creating confidence, with built-in security tech in three segments: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. To our customers, we have been a reliable partner for more than 170 years. With our offering, we are well positioned to support them on their future journey. Discover our innovative SecurityTech solutions!We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to design, secure, and operate our robust development infrastructure across on‑premise and Azure environments. In this role, you will help drive our evolution towards Platform Engineering by enabling self-service capabilities, automation, and a secure software delivery lifecycle. You will be part of a cross‑site, Kanban‑driven DevSecOps team spanning Germany and India, supporting more than 200 developers while helping to ensure secure and reliable product delivery.Key Responsibilities- Own the development platform: Manage, scale, and evolve our development infrastructure, tools, and platform services across on-premises and cloud environments, with Azure DevOps as the CI/CD backbone- Automate infrastructure delivery: Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Ansible and Terraform to ensure scalable, repeatable, and reliable platform deployments.- Build secure CI/CD pipelines: Implement and maintain multi-stage pipelines with integrated security controls, quality gates, and automated testing, following DevSecOps best practices.- Establish AI capabilities: Build and evolve platforms, tooling, and processes for agentic AI solutions, AI-enabled engineering, and self-hosted LLM services.- Observability: Establish and evolve monitoring, logging and alerting to ensure operational excellence.- Mentor & collaborate: Work closely with development teams in Germany and India, promote engineering standards, and support continuous improvement initiatives.- Operational excellence: Create documentation, runbooks, and knowledge assets while participating in incident response and critical delivery activities.Required Skills- Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.- Solid understanding of DevSecOps principles, secure software delivery, vulnerability management, and security automation.-
